# FG-DEPLOY-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `the_requester_cannot_approve_their_own_deployment` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 自分が要求したデプロイや、自分が作ったマージリクエストの変更のデプロイは承認できません。ほかの Maintainer に承認を依頼してください。
- en: You cannot approve a deployment you requested, or one of a change from your own merge request. Ask another Maintainer to approve it.
- id: Anda tidak dapat menyetujui deployment yang Anda minta, atau deployment dari perubahan merge request Anda sendiri. Minta Maintainer lain untuk menyetujuinya.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11 (plan 14 §4.2, ADR-0031 decision 6): authorize() refuses `DeployApprove` when the caller requested the deployment, or authored the merge request whose merge produced the deployed SHA, administrators included. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `action=DeployApprove`, `reason` (`requester` / `merge_request_author`) and the request_id. Read: SELECT requested_by, merge_request_author FROM forge.deployments WHERE id = <deployment_id>;

## 対処 (fix)

Ask another Maintainer of the project (a person, in a web session for prod) to approve.
